text:
Main aapse maafi chahta hoon. Aapka gussa hona bilkul lazmi hai, main samajh sakta hoon ki aap kitne dinon se pareshan hain. 

Maine aapka order ORD-22006 check kiya aur jo refund maine initate kiya hai, uska confirmation aapke registered mobile number par 24 ghante ke andar aa jayega. Yeh amount 5-7 business dinon mein aapke original payment method mein credit ho jayega. 

Agar aapko iske alawa kisi aur cheez mein madad chahiye ya aap kisi human agent se baat karna chahte hain, toh main abhi call transfer kar deta hoon.
